en: Independent Codex Desktop tasks can run on ARC's own backend and return to ARC after the Desktop instance exits, while keeping the configured permissions and dispatch policy.
zh-CN: 独立 Codex Desktop 任务可以在 ARC 自有后端运行，并在 Desktop 实例退出后交还给 ARC，同时保留已配置的权限和派发策略。

en: Task previews, subtask indicators, Agent inventory, quota forecasts and panel transitions are clearer and more consistent.
zh-CN: 任务预览、子任务标识、Agent 列表、配额预测和面板切换更加清晰统一。

en: Antigravity quota comes from its local daemon; cached readings remain available when the client is closed.
zh-CN: Antigravity 配额通过本地服务读取；关闭客户端后仍可查看缓存数据。

en: Improved Codex follow-up delivery and task ownership handback, and fixed focus restoration when nested panels close.
zh-CN: 改进 Codex 后续消息投递和任务归属交还，修复嵌套面板关闭时的焦点恢复问题。
